notes.title: Never 7 Patch 1.01
notes.content:
The following updates have been made to the English and Traditional Chinese version of the game:
[list]
[*] Corrected various spelling errors and typos
[*] Fixed instances of grammatically incorrect text
[*] Addressed issues that were causing bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Ever 17 & Never 7 Now on Steam!
notes.content:
Remastered editions of two classic visual novels by Kotaro Uchikoshi, [i]Ever 17 - The Out of Infinity[/i] and [i]Never 7 - The End of Infinity[/i], are now available on Steam!
A bundle, the [i]Ever 17/Never 7 Double Pack[/i] is also available for purchase.*
Check them out below!

[i][b]Ever 17 – The Out of Infinity[/b][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2392500

[i][b]Never 7 – The End of Infinity[/b][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184620

[i][b]Ever 17/Never 7 Double Pack*[/b][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50132

*The bundle page and links to it may require additional time before showing up/becoming accessible on the Steam store.

notes.title: Ever 17 & Never 7 Coming Soon to Steam!
notes.content:
Store pages for the remastered editions of two classic visual novels by Kotaro Uchikoshi, [i]Ever 17 - The Out of Infinity[/i] and [i]Never 7 - The End of Infinity[/i], have been made public today.
Check out the store pages below to wishlist them and get notified when they are released on March 6!*
There will also be a double pack bundle available at launch.**

[i][b]Ever 17 – The Out of Infinity[/b][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2392500

[i][b]Never 7 – The End of Infinity[/b][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184620

*The titles will be released on March 6 12am PT.
**The bundle page will become public on launch day. The bundle page and links to it may require additional time before showing up/becoming accessible. Stay tuned for more information.
